scheme_name: Self-Employment Scheme: Vahan Loan Sahay Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must have a valid driving license.
The vehicle purchased under the scheme must be mortgaged (hypothecated) to the corporation.
Applicant must be willing to repay the loan in equal monthly installments over 5 years.
Only one person from a family can avail of the scheme benefits.
A maximum of five beneficiaries per village will be selected.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance for on‑road vehicle purchase costs.
